name: Kageyori Shadow Gate
loreTies: Sacred Balance: careful positioning unlocks spirit precision effects.
Kageyori Shadow Gate is a colossal Kami Titan shaped by balance is defended by precision. It manifests the Realm's law through battlefield-scale mythic force.
shortBackstory: Susanoo, Storm-Sea Exile, is one of the four playable god-Titans of the Kami canon. The lore remains the same; the playable form is now the source-realm divinity behind the mythology: storm and sea god, taboo breaker, serpent-slayer, exile-force that tears open stale order.

chapters.title: Origin
chapters.text: Kageyori Shadow Gate began as more than a weapon in The Sacred Kingdoms. Kageyori Shadow Gate was bound to a shrine path folded by spirit wind during a Gate disturbance that tested whether balance is defended by precision could survive contact with the Hollow. The title carried in their name was earned when the Titan chose duty over spectacle and accepted a burden ordinary soldiers could not survive.

chapters.title: Faction Bond
chapters.text: Among the Kami, Kageyori Shadow Gate is treated as proof that a spiritual civilization of sacred duty, ancestral power, shrine law, discipline, nature spirits, and divine balance can become battlefield doctrine without losing its soul. Their silhouette carries lacquered armor, steel, sacred markings, masks, shrine-light, ink, mist, spirit ribbons, but their real identity is tactical: precise control, repositioning, evasion, spirit terrain, disciplined burst. Every deployment makes faction philosophy visible through movement, restraint, and force.

chapters.title: Gate Wound
chapters.text: The Gate did not simply attack Kageyori Shadow Gate; it tried to measure what their Realm values most. The wound echoed sacred doctrine back as bait, tempting the Titan to overextend, break battle line, or turn culture into raw fuel. Kageyori Shadow Gate survived by refusing the Gate's terms, leaving a scar that still reacts whenever precision terrain appears on the map.

chapters.title: Campaign Role
chapters.text: In The First Reopening, Kageyori Shadow Gate gives the campaign a personal lens on faction survival. Their presence reinforces the rule that faction identity stays distinct unless a mission explicitly permits otherwise. In a one-active-Titan Titan, Kageyori Shadow Gate turns Sacred Balance from a passive rule into a story statement: the Realm is defending its meaning.

chapters.title: Personal Conflict
chapters.text: Kageyori Shadow Gate's flaw is overcommitment to the belief that their Realm's answer must always be enough. NPC witnesses and rival factions challenge that certainty as the Hollow learns to imitate law, oath, balance, life, radiance, and ambition without understanding any of them. Their battlefield stats support this arc: HP 32, attack 6, range 3, speed 3, energy 3.

relationshipHooks: Cross-faction envoys can challenge their doctrine without erasing their faction identity.

visualCanon: Sayo is a shrine-cartographer who maps living thresholds. Her ink, mirror charms, shide seals, cedar tools, foxfire lanterns, and quiet ritual posture should feel like the source of later shrine mapmaking and spirit folklore.
